sections.heading: Execution
paragraphs: The 24x7 SOC triages high-severity alerts in 11 minutes median, confirms containment in 42 minutes median and preserves forensic hashes. The 2026-08 ransomware tabletop met all NIST response steps.
The external communications branch opens a customer-communications ticket after legal approves language. The runbook has no Data Protection Board decision owner or board-notification clock.

sections.heading: Recovery
paragraphs: A monthly recovery sample restores encrypted production snapshots and verifies record counts and checksums. September sample BF-09 restored in 38 minutes against a 60-minute target.
